t: Most Haunted: Unseen
d: Stuart enters Gloucester Prison’s Hospital Wing and quickly senses an unseen presence sharing the space with him.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen
d:
Gregg investigates C-Wing which was built on top of an earlier Georgian prison and gets 
more than he bargained for.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen
d: After the team’s investigation at Belan Fort ended, Gregg stayed behind to explore the dark corridors alone — and captured something emerging from the shadows.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Ruthin Castle
d: Yvette & Karl investigate a jewel in the crown of Great Britain, Ruthin Castle. They take on the infamous room 222 and soon realise they are not alone.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Chillingham Castle
d: Karl & Stuart take on one of the Most Haunted rooms in this ancient castle. Whatever is there, seems desperate to make itself known.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Leeds Town Hall
d: Karl ventures alone into the underneath Leeds Town Hall into the dark prison cells that is said to be haunted by a plethora of unhappy spirits, one doesn’t seem happy that Karl is there.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Hodroyd Hall
d: Karl & Stu investigate the attic of Hodroyd Hall, and soon become witness to the many strange occurances. What or who is trying to make contact?

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Champness Hall
d: Yvette, Karl & Stuart investigate the pride of Rochdale, Champness Hall. With loud footsteps and strange noises, the team seem to be followed by a persistent spirit.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Gloucester Prison P1
d: There are many ghost said to haunt Gloucester Prison, from the passive to the most aggressive and as Stuart enters the segregation block he soon fears for his life.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Gloucester Prison P2
d: Some places, just by their name, instill fear into those who hear it, Gloucester Prison is such a lace and Karl investigates the main cell block in an evening he will never forget.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Pen-Y-Lan House
d: Karl & Stuart investigate the top floor of this grand Welsh house. The stories of paranormal activity soon come to life as the duo are surrounded by strange occurrences.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Bron-Y-Garth Hospital Pt1
d: Stuart ventures into Bron-Y-Garth, an old workhouse and abandoned hospital. The spirits that reside here are said to be plentiful, something Stuart finds out all to soon.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Bron-Y-Garth Hospital Pt2
d: Karl takes on the formidable cell block of Bron-Y-Garth,  a former workhouse and abandoned hospital. The dark corridors are said to house many an aggressive entity, and soon Karl finds out first-hand what it they capable of in a climactic end.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Doncaster Air Museum Pt1
d: The famous Air Museum in Doncaster houses many an artefact of aviation history and many spirit from its past. Karl investigates one of the huts that is said to be full of paranormal happenings, and he isn’t disappointed.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Doncaster Air Museum Pt2
d: The main hanger of Doncaster Air Museum is a vast building and houses flying aircraft of every kind. Stuart ventures alone and soon realises something is there with him.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Nunnington Hall Pt1
d: Karl investigates the upper floors of this large manor house that is said to be swarming with paranormal activity of every kind, and gets more than he bargained for.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Nunnington Hall Pt2
d: The creaky corridors and old rooms of Nunnington Hall have many stories of ghosts and phantoms, Stuart investigates the middle floors and starts to experience unexplained happenings.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Shrewsbury Prison Pt1
d: Yvette & Mary enter the vast expanse of the very haunted A-Wing on their own and soon start to regret their decision.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Shrewsbury Prison Pt2
d: With Yvette and Mary investigating A-Wing, Karl & Stuart take on the formidable C-Wing where the unhappy spirits of past residents are said to roam.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Guys Cliffe House Pt1
d: The formidable visage of Guys Cliff House, a once great home, is awe inspiring, as are the stories pf paranormal activity within. Now home to the Masonic fraternity it is home to two temples and many lodges and chapters.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Guys Cliffe House Pt2
d: The lower Temple in this once great, but now ruined castle, is steeped in history and tales pf ghostly happenings. Stuart investigates a room that is said to house multiple spirits and feels something is watching him in the dark.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Dorchester Prison Pt1
d: With paranormal activity of every kind, Dorchester Prison isn’t for the faint hearted. Karl takes on the prison block where aggressive phantoms and poltergeists are said to roam.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Dorchester Prison Pt2
d: With Karl in the main prison block, Stuart checks out the isolation unit, with dramatic results.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Dorchester Shire Hall P1
d: Karl investigates the courtroom of one of Dorchester’s most historical buildings and is suddenly surrounded by unexplained occurrences.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Dorchester Shire Hall P2
d: Under the main building of Dorchester Shire Hall there is a warren of tunnels and cells. Stuart enters this area that is said to house many a phantom.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: York Castle Museum
d: The history of York Castle Museum is almost endless as are the paranormal stories attached to it. Karl enters the street and cells with dramatic effect.

t: Most Haunted: Unseen: Shrewsbury Prison
d: Yvette takes Karl, Stuart and Mary into the vast Shrewsbury Prison. A place riddled with paranormal activity of every kind.
